description: Refget reference sequences belonging to a dataset

id.description: GA4GH sequence identifier (SQ. + sha512t24u digest), resolvable at /ga4gh/refget/v2/sequence/{id}

length.description: Sequence length in bases (bigint, represented as a string per the Data Connect type mapping)

circular.description: True if the sequence is circular

aliases.description: Alternative names for the sequence, sorted by naming authority then alias

naming_authority.description: Authority that issued the alias, e.g. insdc, refseq

drs_uri.description: Hostname-based DRS URI of the DRS object backing this sequence; joins to drs_object.drs_uri
